learning_outcomes.text: Explain in plain terms what artificial intelligence is and how it is being applied in real estate
Describe the main categories of AI use case relevant to real estate and the tasks each suits
Judge which real estate tasks are and are not appropriate for current AI tools
Identify data, bias, privacy and reliability risks specific to AI in real estate
Explain why human oversight and validation remain essential for real estate AI outputs
Distinguish realistic near-term real estate capabilities from speculative or overstated claims

integrative_case: A brokerage weighs AI for listings, document handling and valuation support: assess the fairness, accuracy and disclosure risks, decide which outputs an agent must verify, and advise on adoption.
